description: A small hand-written Inspect log (log.json, one epoch) that pins the rulings settled 2026-10-10. Its model acme/gpt x becomes model:acme/gpt%20x. Of eval.model_roles, grader and grader_b share one judge model, written once, and attacker is no judge. The epochs reducer collect has no AEF value: with one epoch it is kept in run.json's ext. Without stats.started_at, eval.created stands for the start, listed last in imported.asserted. An empty explanation and empty content give no blob. The NaN member of a map gets no score. A sample stopped by a token limit gives the reason "token limit 1000", and an error message of 5,074 characters is cut to its first 4096. A limit is written from its value alone, as ECMAScript's Number::toString writes it: 1000.0 gives "token limit 1000", 1e16 "token limit 10000000000000000", 1e21 "message limit 1e+21"; an error with an empty message gives "Inspect recorded an error without a message". Two roles that land on one AEF role and model are added together; without stats.model_usage, the run's usage comes from role_usage. A results entry with no metric is a plain mean entry, with nothing of Inspect's to compare. Sample h's content that is not text (an input of messages, a ModelOutput with members out of order, 1.0 and 2.50, and keys whose UTF-16 order differs from their code-point order) becomes blobs serialized by JCS, RFC 8785, so their names depend on the values alone (IN-8, settled 2026-10-10). Sample ids 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1) and 1000.0 give the caseIds "9007199254740991" and "1000", from their values alone; an error {} is an error without a message. Sample l writes its epoch and token counts as 1.0, 7.0 and 1.0: every integer field is read by its value (IN-6, IN-8, IN-9, settled 2026-10-10). Each file under refusals/ changes one thing the page refuses: an empty limit type, a NaN limit, a NaN inside content that is not text, which JCS cannot write (IN-8); a log that is not I-JSON (a member named twice, an unpaired surrogate, Infinity, 1e400), a NaN where no unscored value can be, nesting deeper than ENC-17's 64, and a task_version 2.5 (IN-6); a sample id 1.5 or 9007199254740993, an error that is a string, a limit {} on a scored sample (IN-8); a NaN in a list-valued score, and a bare NaN as a member name in content that is not kept, which is not JSON (IN-6); a score whose value is the string "\u0000NaN\u0000", a string and not NaN (IN-7); members of a type Inspect does not write (samples as a string, results.scores as an object, a role as a string, an explanation as a number), a negative cost, and a total_tokens of 1.5 (member types, settled 2026-10-10).
